close_reason: Migrated CalendarsBackend trait UTCDate signatures: compute_utc_times return is now (Option<UTCDate>, Option<UTCDate>); get_availability params are now &UTCDate. Updated doc comment to say 'UTCDate values' instead of 'RFC 3339 strings'. Updated in-source mock backend impl in lib.rs to mirror. Consumer code in event.rs uses .into_inner() to push the inner String into JSON; principal.rs constructs UTCDate via UTCDate::from on the wire string. Wire format unchanged. All 68 calendars-server tests pass. cargo clippy -D warnings and RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc clean.
description:
Audit follow-up from JMAP-g7wu.9.5. Two CalendarsBackend trait method signatures still use String/&str for UTCDate values; migrate to UTCDate.

Sites (all in crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/):

backend.rs:
1. lines 273-280 — CalendarsBackend::compute_utc_times returns (Option<String>, Option<String>); should be (Option<UTCDate>, Option<UTCDate>).
   Doc at line 261 says 'Returns (utc_start, utc_end) as RFC 3339 strings' — should say 'as UTCDate values'.
   
2. lines 452-453 — CalendarsBackend::get_availability takes _utc_start: &str, _utc_end: &str; should be &UTCDate.

3. lib.rs:711-719 — the in-source test backend impl mirrors compute_utc_times's signature and must move in lockstep.

Coordination context:
- JMAP-g7wu.9.3 already migrated TasksBackend::compute_task_utc_times to return UTCDate. This is the calendars-side equivalent and was noted as out-of-scope-but-equivalent in that bead's comment.
- JMAP-g7wu.9.4 already migrated the calendars-client principal_get_availability method to take &UTCDate. The server-side trait is the matching server-half of that wire change — and they belong in the same SemVer step so a re-implementor of CalendarsBackend isn't broken by .9.4 going first.
- Consumer call sites in calendars-server/src/event.rs:117-124 will need to adjust to consume Option<UTCDate> directly (instead of inserting Value::String) — wire JSON unchanged because UTCDate's Serialize impl outputs the same string.

API break — 0.2.0 class. Coordinate with the type-crate beads (calendars-types specifically) per workspace cookie-cutter rule, because CalendarsBackend::compute_utc_times's return type and CalendarEvent::utcStart wire field interact.

Acceptance:
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-server passes.
- cargo clippy -p jmap-calendars-server -- -D warnings clean.
- Both trait signatures use UTCDate.
- Test backend impl in lib.rs updated.
- Doc comment at backend.rs:261 corrected to match new types.
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-calendars-server --no-deps clean.
title: UTCDate migration in jmap-calendars-server CalendarsBackend trait (compute_utc_times return + get_availability params)
